cases.name: Tanisha Pughsley
cases.about: She was a Montgomery Police Department detective since 2016, and was a criminal justice graduate of Alabama State University. “Our entire community today mourns the death of one of our own, Tanisha Pughsley. Detective Pughsley answered the call to serve, defend and protect our city. We stand today with her family, friends, colleagues and all who loved her, praying for comfort, peace and healing during this tragic time,” Mayor Steven Reed said.

cases.name: Mar'Dresha La'Kayla Stovall
cases.about: Her obituary said, "'Ladybug,' as she was affectionately called, was a beloved daughter, sister and friend. She attended Montgomery Public Schools, and was a Class of 2022 graduate of Sidney Lanier High School. Aspiring to be a Medical Assistant, Kayla was attending Fortis College while working at CSL Plasma Center. She truly lived life to the fullest, and thoroughly enjoyed the simple pleasures in life like: dancing, going to parties, and chatting with family and friends. Kayla lived a full and warm life filled with fun, laughs and joy. She also had the most amazing smile."
cases.narrative: Online reports show she was in a vehicle and was shot from outside.
